command:
bash -lc tmp=$(mktemp); printf '{"schema_id":"redcap-development-lifecycle-packet","task_id":"bad"}
' > "$tmp"; if runtime/bin/redcap lifecycle check --packet "$tmp"; then echo "unexpected success"; rm -f "$tmp"; exit 1; else rc=$?; echo "expected lifecycle failure rc=$rc"; rm -f "$tmp"; exit 0; fi
